summary: Complete frontend testing of 3 new SignaTouch product detail pages. All 8 features tested and working correctly. Fixed missing navigation links from landing page to detail pages.

features_tested.details: Page loads with data-testid='touch-kiosk-page', hero with background image, 'Touch Screen Kiosk' title, 'Interactive Engagement Redefined' tagline

features_tested.feature: Touch Kiosk page has all required sections
features_tested.details: Hero, Quick Specs (40-point, 4K, 8ms, 700cd/m²), Features (40-Point IR Touch, 4K Ultra HD Display, Rapid Response, Tempered Glass), Size Options table (32"-75"), Applications gallery (Retail, Hotel, Museum, Corporate), Full Specs, FAQs (5 items)
Page loads with data-testid='smart-signage-page', hero, 'Smart Signage Kiosk' title, 'Floating Imagery. Premium Impact.' tagline

features_tested.feature: Smart Signage page has all required sections
features_tested.details: Hero, Quick Specs (45% transparency, 600cd/m², 5.7mm, infinite contrast), Features (Transparency, OLED, Slim Profile, Wide Color Gamut), Use Cases (Luxury Retail, Museum, Automotive), Technical Specs, FAQs (5 items)
Page loads with data-testid='self-service-page', hero, 'Self-Service Kiosk' title, 'Empower Customers. Optimize Operations.' tagline

features_tested.feature: Self-Service page has all required sections
features_tested.details: Hero, Benefits Stats (70%, 30%, +22%, 95%), Payment Options (NFC, Card, Receipt), Industries (QSR, Hotels, Healthcare, Retail), Technical Specs, FAQs (5 items)

features_tested.feature: Navigation links between all 3 product pages work
features_tested.details: Cross-links in 'Explore More Solutions' section: Touch Kiosk ↔ Smart Signage ↔ Self-Service all work correctly

features_tested.feature: Back to SignaTouch Products link works on all pages
features_tested.details: All 3 pages have 'All SignaTouch Products' link (href='/signatouch') that navigates back to landing page
Touch Kiosk and Self-Service have 'Request Quote' (2 each), Smart Signage has 'Request Demo' (2), all link to /contact

features_tested.feature: FAQ accordions work on all 3 pages
features_tested.details: 5 FAQs on each page with working expand/collapse animation via framer-motion

features_tested.feature: Links from SignaTouchLanding.js product cards go to correct detail pages
features_tested.details: FIXED: Added 'Learn More' links to product cards that navigate to /signatouch/touch-kiosk, /signatouch/smart-signage, /signatouch/self-service

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Console warning about HTML nesting in table (span inside tbody) from FadeIn animation wrapper - does not affect functionality
context_for_next_testing_agent: SignaTouch product family now has 4 pages: 1) Landing page at /signatouch with product cards linking to detail pages, 2) Touch Screen Kiosk at /signatouch/touch-kiosk, 3) Smart Signage at /signatouch/smart-signage, 4) Self-Service at /signatouch/self-service. All pages have cross-links to each other and back to landing. No backend API - all content is static. Uses amber/gold accent colors.
